title: AI & Machine Learning Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to request your AI and machine learning data from companies. Protect your privacy with this customizable letter for data requests.
description: A comprehensive letter template to request information about how AI systems and machine learning algorithms collect, process, and use your personal data. Perfect for submitting privacy requests to AI companies and platforms.

sections.heading: Letter Header
Personal Information
Data Request Details
sections.content:
Under applicable privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA, etc.), I hereby request the following information regarding your AI and machine learning data processing activities:

1. What personal data about me is collected and processed by your AI systems?
2. What specific AI models or algorithms process my data?
3. How is my data used to train machine learning models?
4. What inferences or profiles have been created about me through AI analysis?
5. Do you share my data with third-party AI services or model training?
6. How long do you retain data used for AI training and processing?
7. What automated decision-making affects my account or experience?

sections.heading: Specific AI Services
sections.content:
Please provide details specifically regarding these AI-powered features or services I have used:

{{ai_services}}

I am particularly concerned about:
- Voice and speech recognition data
- Behavioral pattern analysis
- Predictive modeling based on my activity
- Facial recognition or biometric processing
- Content recommendation algorithms

placeholders.label: AI Services Used
placeholders.defaultValue: [List specific AI features, chatbots, or services you've interacted with]

sections.heading: Data Rights Request
sections.content:
In addition to the information above, I am exercising my right to:

☐ Access all personal data processed by AI systems
☐ Receive a copy of my data in a portable format
☐ Correct any inaccurate AI-generated profiles or inferences
☐ Delete my data from AI training datasets
☐ Opt-out of AI-powered automated decision making
☐ Object to AI processing for marketing or profiling purposes

Please confirm which of these rights apply under your jurisdiction and privacy policy.

sections.heading: Response Timeline
sections.content:
I understand you have {{response_days}} days to respond to this request under applicable privacy laws. Please provide your response in writing to this email address: {{contact_email}}

If you need additional information to verify my identity or process this request, please contact me promptly.

sections.heading: Closing
